response.sql: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT c.location AS city, COUNT(q.qualifyId) AS qualifying_count FROM circuits AS c LEFT JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId WHERE c.location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.location), shares AS (SELECT city, qualifying_count, 1.0 * qualifying_count / SUM(qualifying_count) OVER () AS qualifying_share FROM city_counts), city_averages AS (SELECT city, qualifying_count, qualifying_share, AVG(qualifying_share) OVER () AS average_city_share FROM shares) SELECT city, qualifying_count, qualifying_share, qualifying_share - average_city_share AS share_above_average FROM city_averages WHERE qualifying_share > average_city_share ORDER BY share_above_average DESC, city

assumptions.assumption: A qualifying count counts rows in qualifying; a city is circuits.location. The average includes circuit cities with zero qualifying rows.

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate the average share only among cities with at least one qualifying row.
